queries.name: topRated
queries.sql:
SELECT food_place.place_id AS id, food_place.place_name AS name, avg(review.rating) AS rating, count(review.content_id) AS "reviewCount" 
FROM food_place JOIN content ON content.place_id = food_place.place_id JOIN review ON review.content_id = content.content_id 
WHERE food_place.archived_at IS NULL AND content.removed_at IS NULL GROUP BY food_place.place_id, food_place.place_name ORDER BY avg(review.rating) DESC, count(review.content_id) DESC, food_place.place_id
 LIMIT 3 OFFSET 0

queries.name: mostFavourited
queries.sql:
SELECT food_place.place_id AS id, food_place.place_name AS name, count(favourite.user_id) AS "favouriteCount" 
FROM food_place JOIN favourite ON favourite.place_id = food_place.place_id 
WHERE food_place.archived_at IS NULL GROUP BY food_place.place_id, food_place.place_name ORDER BY count(favourite.user_id) DESC, food_place.place_id
 LIMIT 3 OFFSET 0

queries.name: cuisineCoverage
queries.sql:
SELECT cuisine.cuisine_name AS name, count(distinct(food_place.place_id)) AS "venueCount" 
FROM cuisine JOIN place_cuisine ON place_cuisine.cuisine_id = cuisine.cuisine_id JOIN food_place ON food_place.place_id = place_cuisine.place_id 
WHERE food_place.archived_at IS NULL GROUP BY cuisine.cuisine_id, cuisine.cuisine_name ORDER BY count(distinct(food_place.place_id)) DESC, cuisine.cuisine_name, cuisine.cuisine_id
 LIMIT 3 OFFSET 0

queries.name: affordableItems
queries.sql:
SELECT dish.dish_id AS id, dish.dish_name AS name, dish.price, food_place.place_name AS place, food_place.place_id AS "placeId", food_place.is_sample AS "isSample" 
FROM dish JOIN food_place ON food_place.place_id = dish.place_id 
WHERE food_place.archived_at IS NULL AND dish.is_available IS 1 ORDER BY dish.price, dish.dish_id
 LIMIT 3 OFFSET 0

queries.name: affordableMenus
queries.sql:
SELECT food_place.place_id AS id, food_place.place_name AS name, avg(dish.price) AS "averagePrice", count(dish.dish_id) AS "dishCount", food_place.is_sample AS "isSample" 
FROM food_place JOIN dish ON dish.place_id = food_place.place_id 
WHERE food_place.archived_at IS NULL AND dish.is_available IS 1 GROUP BY food_place.place_id, food_place.place_name, food_place.is_sample 
HAVING avg(dish.price) <= 12.00 ORDER BY avg(dish.price), food_place.place_id
 LIMIT 3 OFFSET 0
